AActor::IsOverlapping (AActor vtable +456, unnamed in the idb; found through execIsOverlapping 0x2cd6c0). Three gates converted in Engine/Src/UnActor.cpp. (1) the outer per-component loop drops its blocking test entirely and keeps only `!= NULL && IsAttached() && CollideActors`; (2) the inner loop gains the symmetric pair `MyPrimComp->m_CollisionTraceTypes.MatchesTraceFlags(Other, 0) || OtherPrimComponent->m_CollisionTraceTypes.MatchesTraceFlags(this, 0)`, i.e. either side's mask stopping a movement trace by the other is enough; (3) the box-overlap branches do the same with BoxActor / PrimitiveActor as the source actors. TraceFlags is the literal 0 at all five call sites, so MatchesTraceFlags falls through to the source actor's pawn / player-pawn state. This is the function whose FALSE return was end-touching every actor the frame after it began touching (measured: 4558 begin / 4558 end per 85 s of pure churn before, 250 / 240 stable after)

Branches in the decompile's order: all four gameplay bits + TracesForAllMove -> BlockAll / TouchAll; all gameplay, no move, blocking -> BlockGameplay; VisionLOS only, no other gameplay, no move, blocking -> BlockNPCVision; all move, no gameplay -> BlockMovement / TouchMovement; TraceForMove_Player only, no gameplay, blocking -> BlockMovement_PlayerOnly. Block versus Touch is (bBlockActors && CollisionComponent->BlockActors) everywhere. Engine/Src/UnActor.cpp:2049

AActor::SetCollisionFromCollisionType (unnamed in the idb; called from SetCollisionType 0x18a390). The inverse mapping: every case clears the mask and sets the bit group its collision type names, COLLIDE_CustomDefault copies the whole mask off the class default's collision component (`*(comp+320) = *(defaultcomp+320)`), and the tail sets `bPathColliding = m_bTraceForMove_NonPlayerPawn ? bStatic : FALSE` before mirroring BlockRigidBody. Retail's COLLIDE_NoCollision does not clear bBlockActors and its BlockAll does not call SetBlockRigidBody, both of which the reference did. Engine/Src/UnActor.cpp:2150
